name: Snatch and Grab
summary: Snatch and Grab is an undercover assignment given to promising rogues by Master Mathias Shaw, leader of SI:7. It tasks operatives with infiltrating Jerod's Landing to steal shipping intelligence from the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Test of Tradecraft
sections.body: For an aspiring operative in Stormwind, standing before Master Mathias Shaw is the true test of entry into the kingdom's covert intelligence wing. Rather than relying on simple brute force, Shaw demands proof of finesse and stealth. Taking down key figures quietly and retrieving vital papers without drawing the realm into open scandal is the core mandate of SI:7, and this mission serves as an initiate's proving ground.

sections.title: Smugglers on the River
sections.body: Jerod's Landing sits on the river in southern Elwynn, south of Goldshire and just east of the Maclure Vineyards. Though once a quiet local dock, the Defias Brotherhood seized control of the site to establish an illicit transit corridor. By ferrying smuggled arms, supplies, and contraband across the waters from Redridge down toward Westfall, the thieves bypass royal road patrols entirely.

sections.title: Plausible Deniability
sections.body: Shaw makes SI:7's standing doctrine abundantly clear before dispatching agents into the field: should the operative be captured, compromised, or slain, the Crown and its spymasters will disavow all knowledge of their existence. Recovering the Defias Dockmaster's schedule secures crucial proof of the Brotherhood's supply lines while keeping Stormwind's official involvement in the shadows.

faq.q: Who assigns the quest Snatch and Grab?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw, leader of Stormwind's intelligence service SI:7, gives the quest from inside the SI:7 headquarters in Old Town.

Jerod's Landing is a dock on the river in southern Elwynn Forest, south of Goldshire and just east of the Maclure Vineyards. The Defias Brotherhood has commandeered the docks and the dock house there.

faq.q: What are the Defias smuggling through Jerod's Landing?
faq.answer: The Defias use Jerod's Landing to move large shipments of contraband and supplies across the water between Redridge and Westfall, circumventing kingdom watchposts and road checkpoints.

faq.q: Who carries the Defias Shipping Schedule?
faq.answer: The shipping schedule is carried by the Defias Dockmaster, who can be found guarding the dock house at Jerod's Landing.

faq.q: What happens if an operative is captured during this mission?
faq.answer: As Master Mathias Shaw warns, SI:7 operates with strict plausible deniability. If an operative is exposed or captured, SI:7 will disavow all connection to them.

faq.q: Why does SI:7 care about this shipping schedule?
faq.answer: The document details how the Defias Brotherhood moves contraband between Redridge and Westfall. Securing it allows Stormwind's intelligence network to map out enemy logistics without alerting the syndicate.

angles.text: This mission marks a rogue's formal introduction to SI:7, testing stealth and cutpurse instincts to earn recognition and a signature blade from Mathias Shaw.
Intercepting Defias supply chains at Jerod's Landing protects Elwynn Forest and chips away at the criminal syndicate threatening Stormwind's surrounding territories.
